description: We are Team Peshawar Orbiters from Peshawar, building a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer for NASA Space Apps Challenge. We have strong skills in C++, problem-solving, and strong communication. We love space, tech, and teamwork. We are looking for members with design, presentation, and coding skills to build an impactful project together. Join us to learn, create, and win!
summary:
Junior Astronaut Trainer is an educational space exploration game developed by Team Peshawar Orbiters for the NASA Space Apps Challenge.

Our project aims to make space science interesting and easy to understand for children. Through our game, young learners can take the role of an astronaut and explore two exciting destinations: the Moon and Mars.

Players can discover space environments, explore astronaut bases, and learn about important survival systems such as oxygen supply, protective shields, base facilities, and other essential resources.

Our main idea is to turn learning into an adventure. Instead of only reading about astronauts, children can explore, interact with the space environment, and understand the challenges of living beyond Earth.

This project encourages curiosity, problem-solving, scientific thinking, and interest in space exploration.

Our mission is to inspire the next generation of astronauts, scientists, and space explorers through interactive learning.
